values.meaning: Time Camille is attached to terrain, able to cast Wall Dive
values.quote: dash toward and attach to the terrain for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which she gains the ability to cast
values.binNote: Wiki description states 0.75 seconds for the terrain-attach/Wall Dive window, but the bin's CamilleE.WallHangDuration is 1. Reporting the wiki's stated number as this is a damage-fight-irrelevant utility value in any case, but the discrepancy is a genuine finding, not a typo I'm resolving.

mechanics.claim: Wall Dive's range is doubled towards enemy champions within 1400 units, from 400 to 800.
mechanics.quote: ''Wall Dive's'' range is doubled towards enemy {{tip|champions}} within 1400 units

mechanics.claim: Camille stops prematurely upon colliding with an enemy champion and knocks back/stuns all nearby enemy champions.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' stops prematurely upon colliding with an enemy champion, {{tip|airborne|knocking back}} all nearby enemy champions

mechanics.claim: Wall Dive deals damage to enemies near the landing location (AoE), not a single target hit.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies near the landing location

mechanics.claim: Wall Dive counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects like Spellblade.
mechanics.quote: ''Wall Dive'' count as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: Wall Dive can be blocked by spell shields.
Camille is knocked down (dash interrupted) by any immobilizing or polymorphing crowd control during Hookshot's dash.
mechanics.quote: '''Camille''' will be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} by any {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphing}} crowd control during the dash

mechanics.claim: Casting The Hextech Ultimatum causes the grapple to disappear if it is in flight.
mechanics.quote: Casting {{ai|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} will cause the grapple to disappear if it is in flight
